newsitem.title: FINLAND: FORECAST - Rauma 1996 profit seen flat.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Rauma 1996 profit seen flat.

text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts covering Finnish equities showed a 682 million markka median forecast for Finnish engineering group Rauma Oy's full-year 1996 profit before extraordinary items and tax.
(Profit forecasts by 18 analysts, EPS by 16 analysts).
Rauma's results are due on March 4 at 0900/0700 GMT.
In 1995, Rauma had a 671 million markka profit before extraordinary items and tax.
For the company's full-year 1997 profit, 13 of the 18 analysts polled gave a median forecast of 760 million markka (mean 743 million) in a 640-860 million markka range.

Contributors to the survey were AG Private Bankers, Aktia Bank, Alfred Berg, Aros Securities, BZW Securities, Carnegie Securities, Den Danske Bank, Enskilda Securities, Erik Selin, Evli Securities, FIM Securities, Handelsbanken, Interbank, Kleinwort Benson, Merita Securities, Opstock Securities, Postipankki and Williams de Broe.
